name: erp-control-web
description: Dukan ERP website: public site, Owner account area and Super Admin console. Developed and operated by TSX-MR.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.build:preview: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode preview && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr --mode preview && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.build:public-release: npm run build && node scripts/audit-links.mjs dist && node scripts/audit-bundle.mjs dist --public
